components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action of a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #4B4FE0; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 16px/19px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second action, e.g. Back to home under Next test.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #ECECFE; color: #4B4FE0; font: 600 16px/19px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B4FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet actions such as Delete this result.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #4B4FE0; font: 600 16px/19px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B4FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Numeric and text entry with a 1.5px stroke.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 14px/19px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; color: #0B1020; } .ds-input { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid #E7EAF2; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1020; font: 400 16px/23px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #4B4FE0; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Pill choices such as the theme selector or test version.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-seg-item { padding: 10px 16px; border: 1.5px solid #E7EAF2; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1020; font: 600 14px/19px system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4B4FE0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg-on { background: #ECECFE; border-color: #4B4FE0; color: #4B4FE0; }

narrative.northStar: The scientific instrument with human warmth
narrative.overview: Kinetra reads like a precise measuring instrument that a beginner is still comfortable holding. The precision comes from restraint: deep ink or soft paper surfaces, hairline borders instead of shadows, one confident indigo for action and a mint signal reserved for progress. The warmth comes from generous spacing, softly rounded forms, plain language and a tone that never judges a result.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by 1px hairlines; no drop shadows.
One accent (indigo) for action, one signal (mint) for progress, status colours only for meaning.
System fonts (SF Pro / Roboto) for full Romanian and Cyrillic coverage.
Soft geometry: 12px controls, 20px cards, pills for choices and status.
Honest labelling everywhere: measured, calculated, estimated, reported.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber and coral appear only when something needs care or went wrong. They never decorate, and a low result is never coloured red.

rules.name: The Neutral Unknown Rule
rules.body: Anything not yet known uses Unknown Slate with a dashed outline, never a warning or error colour.

rules.name: The No Verdict Colour Rule
rules.body: Changes between results are signed numbers in text colour, never green or red.

rules.name: The Text Contrast Rule
rules.body: Indigo text always uses brandText, never brand: body-size text needs 4.5:1 in both themes.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: A display face may be added later through expo-font, but every screen must still work in the system font with Romanian diacritics and Cyrillic.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px hairline or a tonal step, never with a shadow.

dos: Do take every colour, spacing and radius from mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts through useTheme().
Do give each screen one primary (indigo) action; put a second action in the secondary style.
Do label every value with its provenance (measured, calculated, estimated, reported).
Do check every new screen in light and dark, and in Romanian, English and Russian.
donts: Don't add drop shadows; use a hairline or a tonal step.
Don't colour a result as good or bad, or a change as green or red.
Don't show an overall score, a ranking, or a comparison with other people.
Don't use amber or coral for anything that isn't a safety note or an error.
Don't encode status by colour alone; pair it with text, shape or a dashed outline.
